candidate_name: RECOPE LNG/Natural Gas Import Initiative (unnamed site)
current_state: RECOPE has repeatedly sought legislative authorization (most recently reported September 2023) to import and sell natural gas, floating two import methods -- isotank containers (non-marine, truck/rail-transported) and an unspecified 'extracción marítima' via ships/barges -- budgeted at roughly $20M for initial isotank rental, with a possible transition to larger storage infrastructure after 2035. No terminal site has been selected (Moín and Barranca are both mentioned only as existing/candidate RECOPE infrastructure, not a chosen site); no SETENA environmental filing or FID has been reported; the legislative reform faced opposition from environmental groups and multiple political parties. This is consistent with a string of RECOPE natural-gas feasibility studies dating to at least the early 2010s (an SNC-Lavalin/Enerchem Tek study once targeted an LNG receiving terminal near RECOPE's Moín Caribbean terminal in Limón for a 2015 in-service date) that have never advanced past the study/legislative stage, plausibly because Costa Rica's grid is ~98% renewable.
missing_threshold_elements: No concrete step (legislative import authority not granted; no site selected; no environmental permit filed; no FID) and scope remains unresolved: the isotank method described is a non-marine, trucked/railed import mode that would fail the marine-import scope gate outright, while the vague 'extracción marítima via ship/barge' description is undefined and not yet verifiable as a genuine ship-borne LNG receiving facility.
watch_for: Legislative approval of RECOPE's natural-gas import authority; a SETENA environmental-impact filing; a named site (Moín vs. Barranca) and named terminal operator; any FEED or terminal-design contract award; confirmation that the import mode is genuinely marine (ship-delivered), not isotank/trucked.
notes: From the coverage-gap discovery sweep of Belize, Costa Rica, Guatemala, and the Falkland Islands (all zero GEM LNG-terminal records as of the 2026-08-11 export). Re-check in ~12 months. Do not stage as new_terminal absent a named site, a resolved marine-vs-trucked scope determination, and a concrete regulatory step.
